title: InferenceOutputResponse
description: JSON response schema returned by the SIH26103 early-warning inference endpoint.

cost_overrun_probability.description: Predicted probability of cost overrun >= 10% from cost_overrun_model.joblib.

cost_overrun_flag.description: Binary early-warning alert: 1 if cost_overrun_probability >= cost_overrun_threshold, else 0.

cost_overrun_threshold.description: Locked operating decision threshold for cost overrun classification.

delay_probability.description: Predicted probability of delay >= 60 days vs revised deadline from delay_model.joblib.

delay_flag.description: Binary early-warning alert: 1 if delay_probability >= delay_threshold, else 0.

delay_threshold.description: Locked operating decision threshold for delay classification.

predicted_delay_months.description: Continuous prediction of total calendar months delayed from original baseline from delay_regressor.joblib.

overall_risk_level.description: Deterministic rule-based composite risk category: CRITICAL if both cost and delay flagged; HIGH if either cost or delay flagged; MEDIUM if probability >= 0.30; LOW otherwise.
